description: This file contains unit tests for the DoubleRange class in the org.openmrs.util package, specifically testing its methods such as equals, compareTo, contains, toString, hashCode, and accessors.

classes.name: DoubleRangeTest
classes.description: A test class containing JUnit test cases for the DoubleRange class methods and behavior.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueForTheSameObjectTypeAndFalseForDifferentTypeObjects
methods.description: Tests that the equals method correctly returns true when comparing with the same object type and false otherwise.

methods.name: DoubleRange_shouldReturnNullLowAndHighIfAccessorsAreNotCalled
methods.description: Verifies that a new DoubleRange object without parameters has null low and high accessors.

methods.name: DoubleRange_shouldReturnInfiniteLowAndHighIfCalledWithNullParameters
methods.description: Checks that the constructor sets high to positive infinity and low to negative infinity when nulls are passed.

methods.name: getHigh_shouldReturnCorrectValueOfHighIfHighWasSetPreviously
methods.description: Ensures getHigh returns the set value.

methods.name: getHigh_shouldReturnPositiveInfinityIfHighWasNotSetPreviously
methods.description: Checks that getHigh returns positive infinity if high was initialized with null.

methods.name: setHigh_shouldSetHighToPositiveInfinityOnNullParameter
methods.description: Verifies that setHigh with null sets high to positive infinity.

methods.name: setHigh_shouldCauseHighToHaveTheSetValue
methods.description: Tests that setHigh updates the high value correctly.

methods.name: getLow_shouldReturnCorrectValueOfLowIfLowWasSetPreviously
methods.description: Ensures getLow returns the set value.

methods.name: getLow_shouldReturnNegativeInfinityIfLowWasNotSetPreviously
methods.description: Checks that getLow returns negative infinity if low was initialized with null.

methods.name: setLow_shouldSetLowToNegativeInfinityOnNullParameter
methods.description: Verifies that setLow with null sets low to negative infinity.

methods.name: setLow_shouldCauseLowToHaveTheSetValue
methods.description: Tests that setLow updates the low value correctly.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnPlus1IfThisLowIsGreaterThanOtherLow
methods.description: Tests compareTo when this low is greater than the other range's low.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnMinusOneIfThisLowIsLowerThanOtherLow
methods.description: Tests compareTo when this low is less than the other range's low.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnZeroIfBothLowsAndBothHighsAreEqual
methods.description: Tests compareTo for equal ranges.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnPlusOneIfBothLowsAreEqualButOtherHighIsGreaterThanThisHigh
methods.description: Tests compareTo when lows are equal, but other range's high is greater.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturnMinusOneIfBothLowsAreEqualButOtherHighIsLessThanThisHigh
methods.description: Tests compareTo when lows are equal, but other range's high is less.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldReturn1IfThisRangeIsWiderThanOtherRange
methods.description: Tests compareTo when this range covers a wider interval.

methods.name: contains_shouldReturnTrueIfParameterIsInRange
methods.description: Verifies that contains returns true if the value is within the range.

methods.name: contains_shouldReturnFalseIfParameterIsNotInRange
methods.description: Verifies that contains returns false if the value exceeds high.

methods.name: contains_shouldReturnFalseIfParameterIsEqualToHigh
methods.description: Ensures that the upper bound is exclusive.

methods.name: contains_shouldReturnTrueIfParameterIsEqualToLow
methods.description: Ensures that the lower bound is inclusive.

methods.name: contains_shouldReturnFalseIfParameterIsLowerThanLow
methods.description: Checks that contain returns false if value is below low.

methods.name: toString_shouldPrintTheRangeIfHighAndLowAreNotNullAndNotInfinite
methods.description: Checks string representation when values are finite.

methods.name: toString_shouldPrintEmptyLowIfLowIsInfinite
methods.description: Checks string output when low is negative infinity.

methods.name: toString_shouldPrintEmptyStringIfLowAndHighAreInfinite
methods.description: Checks string output when both bounds are infinite.

methods.name: hashCode_shouldReturnTheSameHashCodeForObjectsRepresentingTheSameInterval
methods.description: Ensures hashCode consistency for equal ranges.

methods.name: toString_shouldPrintEmptyStringIfLowAndHighAreNull
methods.description: Checks string output when range has null bounds.

methods.name: toString_shouldPrintEmptyLowIfLowIsNull
methods.description: Checks string output when low is null.
